purpose: Teach: 優越/数理/復刊/論説/前項/想起/体現/個所

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様への優越的な対応は控えましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're treating customers with respect, not superiority.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Steady eye contact. Professional but not cold. The tone of someone setting a standard, not correcting a mistake.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の数理モデルを社内で検証中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently validating the mathematical model for the new product internally.
lines.style: Attentive acknowledgment with specifics. Slightly leaning forward — showing he's done his homework. Calm, responsive, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 絶版商品の復刊問い合わせが増えていますね
lines.en: We're definitely seeing more inquiries about reprinting out-of-stock titles.
lines.style: Observational, slightly musing. Gentle upward inflection on the observation itself — inviting reflection rather than issuing orders. Thoughtful pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新聞論説に当社の取り組みが取り上げられました
lines.en: Yes — our company's initiatives were actually featured in a newspaper editorial.
lines.style: Pleased but understated. Small smile in the voice. Delivers the news with quiet pride, not boasting. Slight warmth on 'featured.'

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の前項を参考にしましょう
lines.en: Let's use the previous section of the materials as our reference point.
lines.style: Clear, practical direction. Brisk pace but not rushed. The confidence of someone who knows the materials well and is guiding efficiently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の名前を想起しやすい資料を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare materials that make it easier to recall our key clients' names.
lines.style: Responsive and action-oriented. Slight nod in the tone. Demonstrates understanding by reflecting the intent back — not just compliance, but thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社是を体現する社員を表彰しましょう
lines.en: Let's recognize the employees who really embody our company values.
lines.style: Warm directive. Genuine belief in the idea — not bureaucratic. Slight emphasis on 'embody' — it matters to her. Inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約書の重要個所をマーカーで示しました
lines.en: Done. I've marked the key sections of the contract with a highlighter.
lines.style: Efficient, task-complete delivery. Light, conclusive. Brief because the work is finished. Slight satisfaction — the conversation is wrapping naturally.
